question_record.context: A security incident was reported where a potentially malicious URL click was detected involving account `Lucas Grey` with email `Lucas Grey@niseko.alpineskihouse.co`. The URL in question was `http://ym018491661.wittytree-b6f239d6.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io/`. Following this, there was an alert indicating that a malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine, potentially tied to activities like credential theft or network reconnaissance.
question_record.question: As part of a suspicious remote activity alert, which account name was involved in this remote activity?
solution: User with AadUserId `a2d0f7c2-b0a0-43bd-bce0-27d8ae3be4d0` clicked on a potentially malicious URL.
A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked using `powershell.exe` on a machine.
Suspicious remote activity was observed on a machine involving the account `LocalSystem`.

104.name: A potentially malicious URL click was detected
104.description: We have detected that one of your users has recently clicked on a link that was found to be malicious. -V1.0.0.5

51.name: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine
51.description: A malicious PowerShell Cmdlet was invoked on the machine. The Cmdlet may be associated with credential theft, exploitation, network reconnaissance or code injection.

37.name: Suspicious remote activity
37.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: A potentially malicious URL click was detected
